overview.description: The AdvisorShares HVAC and Industrials ETF (HVAC) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in industrials equity. The fund is actively managed, seeking long-term capital appreciation through investments in US companies within the heating, ventilation, and air conditioning (HVAC) industry and broader industrial sector. The funds advisor considers companies for either growth or value opportunities HVAC was launched on Feb 3, 2025 and is issued by AdvisorShares.
